Complete Resource Package.description: Upon activation you receive a daily production of all resources.

Deuterium Package.description: Upon activation you receive a daily production of deuterium.

Collector.description: A Collector focuses on production and trade. Mine output increases, cargo ships fly faster, and cargo bays are larger. This makes moving goods across space more efficient. Only the Collector can build the giant Crawler, which supports resource extraction operations.

Metal Package.description: Upon activation you receive a daily production of metal.

General.description: The General is the military commander of the empire. Their focus is conquest: faster warships, reduced deuterium consumption for recyclers while harvesting, and powerful tactical options in battle. Only a General can build the Reaper, the pride of the fleet.

Platinum Metal Booster.description: +40% more Metal Mine extraction on one planet

Crystal Package.description: Upon activation you receive a daily production of crystal.

Discoverer.description: A Discoverer is driven to explore new frontiers. Research is completed faster, newly colonized planets are larger, and expeditions can uncover uncharted debris fields. Discoverers developed the Pathfinder to exploit those debris fields.
